items.title: BingX EU Secures MiCAR License, Advancing Regulated Crypto Services Across Europe
items.summary: VIENNA, October 15, 2026 – BingX EU (MEGE zweite GmbH) has secured its Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA or MiCAR) license from Austria’s Financial Market Authority (FMA), that will enable the platform to offer regulated crypto services across 29 countries of the European Economic Area (EEA), subject to ongoing passporting arrangements. The authorization marks a significant milestone in BingX’s European expansion, providing EEA users with access to digital asset services under a unified regulatory framework built on transparency, security, and investor protection. items.title: PPI for final demand increases 1.3% in September; goods advance 2.6%, services rise 0.8%
items.summary: The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 1.3 percent in September. Prices for final demand goods rose 2.6 percent, and the index for final demand services advanced 0.8 percent. Prices for final demand moved up 6.3 percent for the 12 months ended in September.

items.title: CPI for all items increases 0.6% in September; gasoline rises
items.summary: In September, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.6 percent, seasonally adjusted (SA), and rose 3.7 percent over the year, not seasonally adjusted (NSA). The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in September (SA), up 2.6 percent over the year (NSA).
